explanations.trigger_explanation: Discharging dredged or fill material into wetlands, streams, or other waters of the United States for crossings, pads, access, or structures commonly triggers a Department of the Army permit under Section 404.

known_unknowns: Project-level confirmation is still needed to determine whether coverage is through a nationwide permit, regional permit, or individual permit.
advisories: Additional review recommended to confirm jurisdictional waters, wetland limits, and whether pre-construction notification is likely required.
notes: Confidence tier 1 because the requirement is directly supported by federal regulation and official United States Army Corps of Engineers permitting materials.
